description: Per-repeat-unit regularity of the DSF2 solenoid compared with HcpC, from helix-pair boundaries
code:
exec(open("work/lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

res,order=parse_pdb("work/AF-P38213.pdb")
o=[r for r in order if 548<=r[1]<=731 and 'CA' in res[r]['atoms']]
ss=dssp_like(res,o); nums=np.array([r[1] for r in o])
CA=np.array([res[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in o])
segs=ss_segments(ss,nums,minlen=5)
print("DSF2 548-731 helices (resnum start-end, length):")
for s in segs: print(f"   {s[0]}-{s[1]}  len {s[2]}")

st=[s[3] for s in segs]
print("\nper-unit comparison (helix pair k -> k+1):")
pu=[]
for i in range(len(st)-2):
    a,b=st[i],st[i+2]; L=min(37,len(CA)-b)
    if L<20: continue
    r=rmsd_after(CA[a:a+L],CA[b:b+L])
    pu.append((nums[a],nums[b],b-a,round(r,2)))
    print(f"   unit starting {nums[a]} vs {nums[b]}   spacing {b-a:3d}   CA-RMSD over {L} res = {r:.2f} A")

# same for HcpC as the regular reference
res2,order2=parse_pdb("work/1OUV.pdb",chain="A")
o2=[r for r in order2 if 'CA' in res2[r]['atoms']]
ss2=dssp_like(res2,o2); n2=np.array([r[1] for r in o2]); C2=np.array([res2[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in o2])
s2=ss_segments(ss2,n2,minlen=5); t2=[s[3] for s in s2]
hc=[]
for i in range(len(t2)-2):
    a,b=t2[i],t2[i+2]; L=min(36,len(C2)-b)
    if L<20: continue
    hc.append(rmsd_after(C2[a:a+L],C2[b:b+L]))

plt.figure(figsize=(8.2,4.2))
x=np.arange(len(pu))
plt.bar(x-0.2,[p[3] for p in pu],0.4,color="#d62828",label="DSF2 548-731")
plt.bar(np.arange(len(hc))+0.2,hc,0.4,color="#1f4e79",label="HcpC 1OUV (regular Sel1 solenoid)")
plt.axhline(2.0,ls="--",c="#555",lw=1); plt.text(0.1,2.1,"2 A: regular-repeat threshold",fontsize=7,color="#555")
plt.xlabel("repeat unit index along the solenoid"); plt.ylabel("CA-RMSD of unit k on unit k+1 (A)")
plt.title("DSF2's repeat array is irregular: only the 643-721 units\nsuperpose like a genuine Sel1 solenoid",fontsize=10)
plt.xticks(x,[str(p[0]) for p in pu],fontsize=7.5); plt.legend(fontsize=8); plt.grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nDSF2 median unit-on-unit RMSD:",round(float(np.median([p[3] for p in pu])),2),
      " HcpC:",round(float(np.median(hc)),2))
pd.DataFrame(pu,columns=["unit_start","next_unit_start","spacing_res","CA_RMSD_A"]).to_csv("comparison_dsf2_unit_regularity.csv",index=False)
